name: Rzeszów

queries.query: Rzeszów Poland official cadastral parcel map GIS geoportal ewidencyjne
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the national Geoportal/GUGiK EGiB and ULDK services and the official Rzeszów municipal Geoportal WFS. The city BIP identifies the municipal Geodesy Department and its Geoportal for cadastral maps and resource requests.

queries.query: Rzeszów Polska oficjalny geoportal mapa działki ewidencyjne kataster
queries.result: Polish first-party discovery confirmed the City of Rzeszów Geodesy Department, the municipal Geoportal, and the public WFS layer Działki (ewns:dzialki). GUGiK documentation states EGiB is maintained by starosts or presidents of cities with county rights; Rzeszów's municipal BIP provides local map/service evidence.

registryEvidence.custodian: City of Rzeszów, Wydział Geodezji (municipal geodesy department), with the municipal Geoportal; national EGiB framework is documented by GUGiK.
registryEvidence.scope: Rzeszów municipal cadastral map and public Geoportal WFS parcel layer; the municipal service advertises the city's cadastral extent.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The municipal WFS is local service evidence. GUGiK is the national agency/framework; this packet does not claim national data completeness or runtime admission.

parcelDiscovery.source: City of Rzeszów municipal Geoportal WFS (EwMapa Map Server)
parcelDiscovery.crs: EPSG:4326 response; source advertises EPSG:2178 default and EPSG:2180/EPSG:3857/EPSG:4326 alternatives
parcelDiscovery.compositeKeyProvenance: ID_DZIALKI is supplied by the source and embeds the unit/parcel identity (for example 186301_1.0207.1301/4); no synthetic key was created.
parcelDiscovery.note: The retained sample contains only canonical native IDs and full polygon geometry; other source attributes were not retained.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:4326 in bounded response; capabilities default EPSG:2178

boundedAnonymousResponse.result: Three safe ID+geometry parcel features returned.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. The narrow WFS bbox returned nearby parcels but does not establish that the exact point lies inside one of the three returned polygons; ULDK point lookup returned '-1 brak wyników', which is not treated as citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Rzeszów municipal Geoportal cadastral parcel layer
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public WFS metadata and bounded anonymous parcel geometry verified; citywide completeness, update behavior, and all-service consistency remain unverified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no coordinate shift.
Bounded sample is evidence of service response, not proof of citywide completeness.
The source WFS response exposed additional fields, but only ID and geometry were retained.
ULDK exact-point no-result response is not evidence of absence.
This packet is research only, not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The municipal WFS is currently reachable and returns parcel polygons with stable native IDs. Axis-order behavior, source update cadence, anonymous access stability, and citywide coverage should be independently rechecked before adapter qualification.
